title: Saul pack
description: Minecraft resourcepack with Saul goodman in them
body:
A minecraft resourcepack with on some blocks Saul goodman.

The texture pack is defenitly no masterpiece, but its a fun little project of mine.
So dont expect the best of the best textures :). This texturte pack is for the Better Call Saul fans


Only blocks modified are 512x, more will be added over time!

FOTOS ARE LOWER RES, HIGH IN GAME!

I reccomend using this pack with shaders for a better look
